ov: Marine cephalopods with W-shaped pupils, eight arms and two tentacles, and an internal shell, the cuttlebone, that controls buoyancy. They change colour, pattern and skin shape to hide and to signal.
len: Usually 15–25 cm; up to 50 cm (giant cuttlefish)
df: Small molluscs, crabs, shrimp, fish, octopuses and other cuttlefish.

cf.tip: Cuttlefish, squid and octopuses are cephalopods; the cuttlefish has an internal cuttlebone.

fx: A cuttlefish usually lives only one to two years.
